fields.summary: TC-762-02: Pay Audit Lambda Falls Back to Scheduled Times When Actual Flight Times Are Not Available

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-762

Precondition: A trip exists where actual flight times are null or not yet available. The Pay Audit Lambda must gracefully handle missing actual times - either by using scheduled times as fallback or by flagging the audit for manual review.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a trip record where actualDepartureDateTimeUTC and actualArrivalDateTimeUTC are null on the last leg
Leg: DAL->HOU. scheduledDep=08:00Z, scheduledArr=09:15Z, actualDep=null, actualArr=null
Trip record available in DynamoDB with null actual flight times on the last leg
Trigger the Pay Audit Lambda for the trip with null actual times
Pay Audit Lambda invoked with trip record where actualArrivalDateTimeUTC=null
Lambda is invoked successfully without throwing a NullPointerException
Verify the Lambda handles null actual times gracefully - does not silently use scheduled times as actual or throw unhandled error
actualArrivalDateTimeUTC=null, actualDepartureDateTimeUTC=null
Lambda detects null actual times and either flags the audit for manual review or applies defined fallback behavior - no silent incorrect calculation
Verify the audit status is set appropriately when actual times are missing
Audit status field in DynamoDB after Lambda processing
Audit status is set to Manual Review Required or Failed (not Completed) when actual times are absent
Verify the COA Search App reflects the correct audit status for the trip with missing actual times
COA Search App queried for the trip
COA Search App shows audit status as Manual Review Required or Failed - not Completed with potentially incorrect data
